legal_units.text: For the purposes of sections 20 to 24, the "owner" in relation to a property or any part thereof shall include—

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: an individual who transfers without adequate consideration, any property to the spouse (except under an agreement to live apart), or to a minor child (other than a married daughter);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 25 Interpretation. For the purposes of sections 20 to 24, the "owner" in relation to a property or any part thereof shall include— Section 25(a): an individual who transfers without adequate consideration, any property to the spouse (except under an agreement to live apart), or to a minor child (other than a married daughter);

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: the holder of an impartible estate, and he shall be deemed to be an individual owner in respect of all the properties comprised in the estate;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 25 Interpretation. For the purposes of sections 20 to 24, the "owner" in relation to a property or any part thereof shall include— Section 25(b): the holder of an impartible estate, and he shall be deemed to be an individual owner in respect of all the properties comprised in the estate;

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a member of a co-operative society, company or other association of persons to whom a building or part thereof is allotted or leased under a house building scheme of the society, company or association;
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 25 Interpretation. legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a person who is allowed to take or retain possession of any building or part thereof in part performance of a contract of the nature referred to in section 53A of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (4 of 1882);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 25 Interpretation. legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: a person who acquires any rights (excluding any rights by way of a lease from month to month or for a period not exceeding one year) in or with respect to any building or its part—

legal_units.title: Interpretation.
legal_units.text: by virtue of transfer of such property by way of sale or exchange or original or extendible lease for a term of not less than twelve years; or
